tone.target: mid-gain indie pop-rock with chorus wash and clean delay accents
tone.profile: mid-gain indie pop-rock with chorus wash and clean delay accents
tone.summary: A clean, modulated signal chain featuring Chorus and a low-gain amp (US Deluxe) with subtle delay for atmospheric indie pop sound.
corrections: keep modulation as the main signature

rig.name: Twenty One Pilots - Stressed Out - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal for clarity and punch in verses.
blocks.gap: The Boost pedal is used here to simulate a gentle clean boost rather than an aggressive OD, fitting the 'slight verse crunch' requirement without adding grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide the signature chorus wash and modulation required for indie pop sound.
Maintain a clean signal path while allowing for subtle harmonic richness (low-gain requirement).
blocks.gap: Using 'None' is the best way to ensure minimal coloration and keep the tone pristine, focusing gain control on the amp section.

blocks.purpose: Provide a clean, articulate platform suitable for arpeggios and pop tones.
Match the clean, articulate sound of the US Deluxe amp.
Slightly scoop the mids and enhance clarity in the upper frequencies for pop radio sound.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the frequency response, compensating for potential muddiness from chorus/delay.

blocks.purpose: Add atmospheric delay accents for the 'wash' and depth required in indie pop.
Provide subtle space and depth without sounding overly wet or dramatic.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring for a natural, non-intrusive ambient wash.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more natural, articulate pop-rock sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the clean, open tone for arpeggios and chorus wash.
